Subject: particle physics | ID: 22721

Statement

Let H be a Paley-Wiener space. Every diagonalizable operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the polynomial spectral family \(P_{01330011}\), the image is precompact in the real manifold topology.

Step 3. By the skew-symmetric spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the skew-symmetric spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Fourier interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
